profile.headline: Telephony Engineer (Avaya)
profile.summary: Dedicated telecommunications professional with experience with voice network, Avaya PBX and related equipment.  Extensive customer service and end-user access management skills.  Thorough understanding of tariffs and regulations related to the industry.  Expertise in time management, negotiations, scheduling, research and analysis.  Work well independently and as a team leader to complete projects in a timely manner.  Excellent oral and written communication, interpersonal, and PC skills

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
June 2021 – Present
•	Extensive knowledge of Contact Center products and services
•	Extensive knowledge of Avaya Vectoring, hunt groups, VDN’s, Service Hour Tables and CTI Routing and skill based routing.
•	Provision call flow from the JIRA platform request..
•	Work closely with testing and IVR team to develop and execute end-to-end test scenarios involving PBX and IVR routing ensuring 100% test coverage.
•	Provision TFN’s through the ENUM environment.
•	Add skills and make changes in the ETS system known as the Transfer Matrix
•	Create and schedule change request for implementation through Cherwell

positions.title: Sr Tax Professional (Seasonal)
positions.description: Prepare tax returns seasonally.  Qualified professional able to complete Acquistion or Abandonment of Secured Property, Itemized Deductions, Self-Employment Income, Capital Gains and Losses, and Supplemental Income and Losses.

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description: Dedicated telecommunications professional with experience with voice network, Avaya PBX, and related equipment.  Extensive customer service and end-user access management skills.  Expertise in time management, detail-oriented, negotiations, scheduling, research and analysis.  Work well independently and as a team leader to complete projects promptly.  Excellent oral and written communication, interpersonal, and PC skills

positions.title: Network Engineer
positions.description: Customer Technology Support – Voice Implementation worked on an enterprise wide security project for Network Perimeter Inventory Controls to document and confirm the need for all modems within all Wells Fargo facilities. Orchestrated site visits with vendors to locate and disable equipment when necessary. Removed or disabled equipment within the Avaya PBX

positions.title: Sr Call Routing Associate
positions.description:
Managed and Routed 800 Service over designated trunks for call centers in multiple locations in the US and abroad.  Wrote and developed scripts and made changes to call flows within the Avaya PBX. Maintained hunt, vectors and skills for call routing.  Arranged translations to route VDNs over SIP and VoIP translations with additonal experience ans support of adjuct devises such as CTI/IVR, Genesys, Call Routing Verint..  Have worked on IVR and BSR platforms.  Provided on-call production support as required. Managed 9 projects and met customer service satisfaction for each one.  Obtained information, responded to inquiries, analyzed documentation and resolved issues.  Supported customers by helping them to maintain security access to the Customer Management System.

•	Completed 804 Service Request at an outstanding 99.6% of Service Level which exceeded the team average for service request
•	Completed 545 trouble tickets, and flexible and helpful when handling last second request that come in as a severity 1 level outage
•	Project Managed Starbucks from the conversant IVR to a CIT Inter Voice IVR
•	Supported the Starbucks work at home agent implementation in order to expand the clients brand
